entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An artificial metallic plane created by the planeswalker Karn, named after the Mirari by Memnarch, orbited by four satellites.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who created the artificial world of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Character introduced by the set's storyline who named the plane after the Mirari.

entities.name: Glissa Sunseeker
entities.description: The finest hunter and perhaps the most skilled warrior of the elves, who sets out to learn why the levelers seek to destroy her.

entities.name: Levelers
entities.description: Monstrous creatures that seek to destroy Glissa.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: The object after which Memnarch named the plane Mirrodin.

events.summary: Glissa begins her story, setting out to find out why the levelers seek to destroy her, which starts to uncover the mysteries of Mirrodin.
events.quote: begins her story to find out why the monstrous "levelers" seek to destroy her

relations.quote: an artificial world created by the planeswalker Karn

relations.note: The levelers seek to destroy her
